mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, description, sort_order AS "sortOrder", status FROM category ORDER BY sort_order, id
INSERT INTO category (code, name, description, sort_order, status) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{description}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE category SET code = #{code}, name = #{name}, description = #{description}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
